errorCodes.meaning: A named version is the attribute's current one. The current value is removed with persona/attribute/delete, never here — a purge that could take the live value would make "tidy up old names" able to erase the present one.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: Success response to persona/attribute/purge-version. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/attribute/purge-version/1.0#response. Purging a version that is not held is a success that purges nothing, so a repeated purge converges.

purged.description: The versions actually removed. Empty when none named was held.

stalePins.description: Profiles that pinned a purged version and now present that entry as stale — which is to say, disclose nothing for it until the holder repins or edits them. Named because a purge that quietly shortened what three faces present is the surprise this family exists to prevent. Absent when none did.

Response.title: Persona Attribute Purge Version — response payload

Ulid.description: A ULID in Crockford base32, uppercase. Used for `attributeId` and `profileId`. Chosen over a UUID because the leading 48 bits are a timestamp, so a key-ordered scan of the store is also creation-ordered and a `list` needs no secondary sort. Server-assigned on create; a producer MAY supply one to make a create idempotent, and a maintainer MUST reject a supplied value that already exists rather than silently overwriting.
Ulid.title: Ulid

Version.description: A value of the store's monotonic write counter. Server-assigned; a producer never chooses one.
Version.title: Version

schema.description: Permanently remove earlier versions of one attribute that the maintainer kept because a profile pins them. The holder's override on retention: after a name change, the old name is kept only while something needs it, and this is how the holder says nothing does.

versions.description: The retained versions to remove. Omit to remove every retained version of the attribute. The current version is never removed by this task — that is persona/attribute/delete.
